function.name: requests_get
function.description: Sends a GET request to the specified URL to retrieve weather data from the Open-Meteo API. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: URL of the Open-Meteo API endpoint.

headers.description: Headers to include in the request. Each key-value pair represents a header field and its value.

Content-Type.description: The MIME type of the body of the request (used with POST and PUT requests).

Accept.description: Media type(s) that is/are acceptable for the response.

timeout.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for the server to send data before giving up. This is a float type value.

params.description: Query parameters for the GET request.

latitude.description: Latitude of the location, positive for N and negative for S. This is a float type value.

longitude.description: Longitude of the location, positive for E and negative for W. This is a float type value.

elevation.description: Elevation in meters above sea level for the location. The default value represents no elevation downscaling.

auth.description: Authentication tuple for HTTP authentication, in the format (username, password).

cert.description: Path to the SSL client certificate file (.pem). A null value means no client certificate is used.

cookies.description: Dictionary of cookies to send with the request. Each key represents a cookie name.

proxies.description: Dictionary mapping protocol names to the URL of the proxy. Each key-value pair represents a protocol and its proxy URL.

stream.description: If True, the response should be streamed; otherwise, it should be downloaded immediately.

verify.description: Whether to verify the server's TLS certificate.

• Has a strong fan base in both Korea and internationally, especially after *The King: Eternal Monarch* aired on Netflix. | --- ### Quick Biography - **Early Life & Education** Park Ji‑sung grew up in Seoul and developed an early interest in performing arts. He studied theater and film at Chung‑Ang University and later earned a master’s degree in acting from Seoul National University, honing his craft through rigorous training. - **Career Beginnings** He debuted in 2000 with the television drama *The Great King Sejong*. His breakthrough came in 2005 with the hit series *The King and I*, where he played a charismatic prince. From there, he steadily built a reputation for taking on diverse roles. - **Rise to Stardom** The 2016 drama *The Legend of the Blue Sea* catapulted him to nationwide fame. His portrayal of a modern-day fisherman who falls in love with a mermaid earned him critical acclaim and the Baeksang Arts Award for Best Actor. - **Recent Projects** In 2020, Ji Sung starred in the Netflix‑distributed fantasy romance *The King: Eternal Monarch*, which garnered a massive international audience. He also appeared in the critically acclaimed drama *The World of the Married* (2019), showcasing his range in a gritty, contemporary setting. - **Personal Life** Ji Sung is known for keeping his personal life private. He is married to actress Kim Hye‑jin (not to be confused with the actress Kim Hye‑jin from *The King: Eternal Monarch*), and they have one child together. --- ### Clarification: Park Ji‑sung vs. Ji Sung - **Park Ji‑sung (actor)** – stage name Ji Sung, born 1979, famous for Korean dramas. - **Park Ji‑sung (footballer)** – a former professional footballer, born 1981, who played for FC Barcelona and the South Korean national team. The two share the same Korean name but are distinct individuals in different fields. --- #### Want More?
